draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and routine, ready to settle the bill at a shop counter
notes: Unlike English 'pay for', 'pagare' takes a direct object without 'per' for the item bought (pagare il caffè = to pay for the coffee). Keep the 'g' hard before 'e' and 'i' by spelling it 'gh' (tu paghi, noi paghiamo).
